headline: ATL @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 4.94 at NYM 3.62, with a projected total of 8.55. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: ATL moved +0.92 runs while NYM moved -0.03, changing the projected margin by +0.95 runs. The projected total climbed +0.89, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Martín Pérez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ozzie Albies, Matt Olson, Mauricio Dubón, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Eli White, Mark Vientos because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
